People Manager for Library – Aarhus

Be a People Manager for experienced developers and help libraries across Europe strengthen the way they work. Join a business unit in fast growth that constantly wins new markets.

The job

As a People Manager, you will be the direct people manager for 10-15 experienced developers across Aarhus, and you coach teams in the Cicero Product Development organisation. Your primary task will be to make sure people feel supported and motivated, and to help the teams become better as a team.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Daily people leadership, including 1:1s, development conversations and performance management

• Creating culture and context by translating priorities, building psychological safety, representing the teams’ point of view upwards and resolving conflicts

• Supporting decisions with data, through better flow, effective reporting and dashboards

• Improving processes with Scrum Masters and teams, both within and across teams, including how we use AI across delivery

• Being part of the Product Development leadership group together with your Associate Director

Joining the team

We are around 70 colleagues in seven teams across Aarhus, Bucharest and Copenhagen. We develop Cicero, a library management system that helps libraries provide communities with knowledge, culture and connection essential to education and democratic societies. All teams run scrum and coordinate through PI Planning. We deliver into the same product, which is released every 14 days. AI is already an integrated part of our development teams, and you will help take it further.

Your qualifications

• A university degree preferred on a master’s level

• Experience within software development and management, or extensive process experience, e.g. as Scrum Master or project manager, and a wish to take the step into your first People Manager position

• Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, SAFe or PI Planning, and general management or project management skills

• Good Jira skills

• Strong communication skills in both Danish and English

On a personal level, you:

• Are comfortable holding both empathy and accountability in the same conversation

• Can influence without always having formal authority, using strong coaching skills

• Stay resilient when switching context between multiple teams and people

• Are comfortable using data to drive decisions

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Maritime Product Manager

Do you have a naval background and a commercial mindset? As Maritime Product Manager, you will use your operational expertise to set the direction of SitaWare Maritime, our command and control product for our navy customers.

The job

As Maritime Product Manager, you are responsible for the vision, strategy and roadmap of our SitaWare Maritime Command and Control product. You act as the operational subject matter expert towards our development teams, translating the needs of maritime operators and commanders into product requirements, and you support Sales and Services in maritime proposals and project delivery. Together with product management peers, UX designers and technical architects, you will define solutions to operational requirements and keep our maritime products aligned with the needs of navies and allied forces. You will engage directly with customers worldwide. The role can develop into Senior Product Manager, management or other parts of the business.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Defining and executing the maritime product strategy, business model and roadmap

• Analysing maritime market opportunities and leading concept development for new capabilities and warfare areas

• Specifying operational and market requirements through customer engagement, military trends and doctrines

• Providing requirements analysis and product guidance for major maritime C2 proposals and customer visits

• Engage with Sales and Services in proposal work, support by providing product guidance and approval of product expansions, and provide them with the necessary product information, sales collateral and assistance at special customer visits

The position requires worldwide travel to customer and non-customer sites approx. 20-30 days a year.

Joining the team

You will join the Defence Product Management team in Aarhus, where Business and Defence Domain Product Managers from both military and commercial backgrounds work together across our defence products. We share knowledge, challenge each other’s thinking and succeed as a team. In this role, you will work closely with Marketing, UX designers, architects, Sales and Services, and with the Product Board and Development leadership. You will also engage directly with customers and future customers to understand their operational requirements and translate them into product capabilities.

Your qualifications

• 8+ years of experience from  in the navy, inclding 5 years as a officer

• A Tactical Officer Course (TOK) or PWO equivalent, or similar military education, is preferred

• Knowledge of the systems and technologies supporting naval warfare, both software and hardware

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

• Experience in presentations and classroom training

• You are a clear communicator and collaborator with an analytical mindset and an enterprising approach. You are results oriented, take decisions with confidence and can lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.

jobs.occupation: Senior ERP Systems Consultant – AX 2012 & D365 F&O
jobs.description:
Senior ERP Systems Consultant – AX 2012 & D365 F&O

Mission

**Do you want to take ownership of two generations of ERP systems at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 and the ambition to play a key role in supporting our current platform while contributing to our transition to D365 F&O? Are you motivated by ensuring system stability and continuous improvement while helping shape the future of our ERP landscape?

If you are a technically strong ERP systems consultant who enjoys solving complex issues, collaborating across IT and the business, and building new capabilities for the future, this could be the opportunity for you.

Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkReporting to our Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business consultants, developers, architects, integration specialists and stakeholders across our international organisation.

As a Senior ERP Systems Consultant, your initial focus will be our existing Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 platform, where you will ensure system stability, performance, technical quality and continuous improvement. As we transition from AX 2012 to D365 F&O, your role will evolve alongside our ERP landscape.

Senior ERP Systems Consultant with a focus on AX 2012 and D365 F&OYou will be our senior technical expert on AX 2012, acting as the escalation point for complex issues and safeguarding critical system knowledge. Working closely with developers, architects and business consultants, you will balance technical debt, maintenance and business-requested enhancements while ensuring that solutions meet our development, documentation and architectural standards.

You will also bring critical AX 2012 knowledge into our transition to D365 F&O, building hands-on experience with the new platform and gradually taking on systems responsibility for the new solution. This is not just an AX 2012 role – it is an opportunity to take ownership across two generations of our ERP landscape and become a key part of our future D365 F&O organisation.

More specifically, your key responsibilities will be to:

• Act as the senior systems and technical expert for our Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 environment, ensuring stability, performance, maintainability and architectural integrity.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and act as the escalation point for critical incidents.

• Work hands-on with AX 2012 development, X++, customisations, integrations, SQL Server and performance optimisation.

• Review technical solutions and ensure adherence to development, documentation and architectural standards, balancing technical debt, maintenance and business-requested enhancements.

• Protect and strengthen critical AX 2012 knowledge through documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Identify customisations, integrations, data dependencies and technical risks in the existing solution as input to the transition to D365 F&O.

• Contribute to solution assessment, data migration, testing, validation and cutover preparation in close collaboration with D365 F&O consultants, developers, architects and integration specialists.

• Build hands-on D365 F&O knowledge and progressively take on responsibility for the operation, maintenance, configuration, release readiness and continuous improvement of the new platform.

Profile

Qualifications & requirementsYou bring extensive hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, supported by several years of experience from complex, business-critical ERP environments. You combine strong technical problem-solving skills with a structured approach to quality and documentation, and you are motivated by the opportunity to apply your AX 2012 expertise during the transition while developing your future role within D365 F&O.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, including System administration, development and architecture.

• Solid experience with X++ development and customization.

• Good understanding of SQL Server, databases, integrations and performance optimization.

• Experience from complex and business-critical ERP environments.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities.

• The ability to balance operational stability, technical debt, transformation activities and business requirements.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience collaborating across functions and cultures.

• A structured and delivery-focused approach, with attention to quality, documentation and agreed deadlines.

It is an advantage if you have:

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.

• Experience from an AX 2012 to D365 F&O migration or another ERP transformation programme.

• Experience with Azure DevOps, Lifecycle Services, data entities, security, workflows or release management in D365 F&O.

• Knowledge of cloud ERP operations, automated testing or the Microsoft Power Platform.

• A relevant degree or Microsoft Dynamics certification.

Personality mattersYou are curious, analytical and collaborative, with a natural ability to take ownership and build trusted relationships across the business and IT. You enjoy solving complex problems, constructively challenging existing solutions and translating technical insight into sustainable improvements. You communicate clearly and thrive in an international environment where knowledge-sharing, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

**We offer more than just a job

**We wish to be the best at what we do, and everything we do is based on our values of “Winning Attitude, Customer Orientation, and Getting it Done”. We offer flexible working hours and numerous employee benefits, counting a healthy canteen, take-away, free fruit, and fitness facilities. Wrist supports local elite sports, offering tickets to home games. You can expect free parking and access to Clever EV charging stations. Moreover, we have an active employee association that invites us all to play paddle, badminton, board games etc. and to join the yearly DHL relay race.

**Ready to apply?

**Please send us your application and CV via the “Apply” button. We want to fill the position as soon as possible and will continuously invite candidates for interviews, so do not hesitate to submit your application and CV.

If you have questions or want to know more about the team, please reach out to Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, at thjo@wrist.com or by phone on +45 2128 4416

**At Wrist, we are committed to cultivating a culture of belonging where every individual feels seen, valued, and respected

**As a global company, we aim to reflect the communities we are part of, believing that our strength comes from diverse perspectives, experiences, and the unique contributions each person offers. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, and we are dedicated to maintaining a recruitment process that is inclusive, fair, and respectful. By fostering a supportive workplace culture rooted in belonging, we lay the foundation for meaningful collaboration and shared success.

**About Wrist

**Wrist is the world’s leading ship and offshore supplier of marine provisions and stores with a market share of approximately 12%. We are the only provisions and stores marine supplier with a global network of supply operations. We also offer services within owners’ goods and spare parts logistics, combining provisions and stores deliveries directly to the vessels. With the launch of the digital marketplace, Source2Sea, Wrist is leading the digital transformation of the marine supply industry. All year round, we offer 24/7 global online sourcing and logistics, providing data transparency, automation, and convenience to our customers. We continuously work on reducing our climate impact while at the same time proactively addressing our customers’ growing demand and need for responsible solutions and services. From more than 30 locations worldwide, in all major shipping locations, 1,800 Wrist employees take pride in making it easy for our customers to order and receive marine supplies and services.

Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation

Help shape how Danske Bank manages risk and compliance through technology that makes a measurable difference. As Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation, you will build and lead a new team, turning complex challenges into practical products, scalable solutions and better ways of working. This is an opportunity to create a new capability and bring innovation into everyday practice across the Risk and Compliance function.

What you will be doing

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of approximately 15 colleagues, combining technology and product specialists with PMO and change-delivery professionals. Reporting to James Mackintosh, Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will work across Risk and Compliance with senior leaders, subject-matter experts and Technology teams. You will set clear direction while building a culture of trust, collaboration and shared responsibility for results.

More specifically, you will:

• Build and lead the Risk and Compliance Innovation team, creating clarity, collaboration and a strong focus on delivery.

• Shape and deliver a technology and change portfolio aligned to strategic, regulatory and operational priorities.

• Deliver practical, production-ready solutions, including AI use cases such as regulatory traceability and digital-twin approaches.

• Translate complex problems into clear product propositions, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.

• Prioritise the team portfolio and budget, making transparent choices and adapting where the expected value is not being realised.

• Establish proportionate delivery governance that supports transparency, sound controls and timely decisions.

About you

• Significant leadership experience in banking or another highly regulated financial-services environment.

• A strong track record of technology and product delivery, from concept through to production and measurable impact.

• Experience using AI, automation and data to improve control, insight, productivity or decision-making.

• Experience leading major transformation programmes across organisational boundaries.

• The ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects and data specialists, without needing to code directly.

• Strong portfolio and commercial judgement, including prioritisation, budgeting and resource allocation.

You will be a collaborative, down-to-earth leader who provides clear direction, listens to different perspectives and helps colleagues turn ideas into practical results. Experience owning products while commissioning delivery from technology partners, or helping recover challenged programmes, would be valuable. Experience working with agile tribes and squads, aligning priorities with product owners and coordinating delivery across teams, would also be an advantage, as well as a background spanning technical delivery and change management.

What we offer you

You will join a collaborative environment where your work can make a meaningful difference to how a major bank manages risk. We offer a hybrid working model with three to four days per week in the office. You will have access to senior stakeholders, an organisation-wide mandate and the opportunity to build a new capability across Risk and Compliance.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Contact hiring manager James Mackintosh at jamma@danskebank.dk with any questions, or apply directly through this posting. Please submit your application by 1 December 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Danske Bank

København V, 1600 København V Besøg hjemmeside

Kontaktperson

James Mackintosh jamma@danskebank.dk

Ansøgningsfrist

1. december 2026 Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation

jobs.occupation: Chief Flight Instructor at GreyBird Pilot Academy - HQ located at Aarhus Airport, DK –  Ready to shape the future of pilot training? ✈️
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is more than a flight school. We are a fast-growing international business in an industry that never stands still – training the next generation of commercial pilots. Since starting out in Aarhus in 2013, we have grown to seven bases across Europe – from Dublin in the west to Helsinki in the east. Our students fly under the Spanish sun and across European airspace. Today, more than 200 students are training to become commercial pilots with us, supported by over 40 flight instructors and a fleet of 12 Tecnam aircraft, with 13 more on the way. This is where ambition becomes reality – where safety, people, technology, operations and training must all come together before the wheels leave the runway. You have an aviation background and have instructed from the cockpit yourself. With us, you will join a highly skilled team with short decision-making lines and plenty of room to shape our development. We turn the dream of flying into a career – and you can help make that journey even better.

The role

The Chief Flight Instructor (CFI) is part of our ATO Core Team and holds overall responsibility for quality, standardisation and compliance in the flight and simulator training delivered by our flight instructors. You are appointed by the Accountable Manager and report directly to the Head of Training, with whom you work closely to ensure consistent, high-quality training. The Head of Training may delegate tasks and authority to you within your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:

• Standardisation, supervision and training planning for the entire instructor team

• Developing and enforcing standard operating procedures for flight training

• Ensuring that all instructors hold valid licences, certificates and competencies

• Recruiting new instructors as well as guiding, mentoring and providing recurrent training for the existing team

• Assessing new bases as we expand into new countries

• Updating training materials and operations manuals on our in-house platform, SmartBird

• Taking part in ATO and management meetings, where you help set the direction for training

What we offer:

• Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

• A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

• An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

• Access to a modern and growing fleet

• An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Requirements

The Chief Flight Instructor is a nominated post under EASA Part-ORA (ORA.ATO.210). In line with the regulation, the CFI must hold the highest pilot licence and at least one instructor certificate relevant to the courses the school offers. As GreyBird offers ATPL theory, several aircraft types and type rating-related training, we are looking for:

• CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

• Instructor certificate: FI(A)

• Additional instructor certificates such as CRI(A) and IRI(A) are considered an advantage

• A minimum of 1,000 hours as PIC, including at least 500 hours of instructional flying (industry practice is typically 1,500+ hours, and more experience counts in your favour)

• Ideally, you also have experience leading, standardising or developing other instructors

• Fluent English, spoken and written

How to apply

Ready to set the course for a role where you shape the standards for the next generation of pilots? Send us your application today – we look forward to hearing from you.

Fraud is constantly evolving, and so is the work we do to protect our customers. In Fraud DK, you will join a team where analytical thinking, good customer dialogue, and close collaboration come together to make a real difference for individuals and society. This is a role where your contributions matter every day.

What you will be doing

You will be part of Fraud DK, one of two Danish teams within Special Risk Operations, working closely with colleagues in Denmark, Lithuania, and the wider Nordic region. The team brings together a diverse mix of backgrounds, experience levels, and educations, creating a social and supportive environment where sparring and knowledge sharing are part of daily life. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders across the bank and engage directly with private and business customers to ensure sound case handling and positive customer experiences.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Handling customer dispute cases and reviewing payments flagged for control

• Assessing alerts, evaluating documentation, and taking steps to mitigate risk

• Navigating a regulatory environment that is regularly updated and changed

• Communicating with internal stakeholders and documenting relevant information in Danish and English

• Maintaining direct customer dialogue with a clear focus on the customer's situation

About you

• Experience in fraud handling, risk mitigation, or general banking

• Strong analytical and methodical approach to complex case work

• Comfortable managing customer conversations as a regular part of work

• Able to adapt quickly when regulations, procedures, or fraud patterns shift

• Fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

A certification from ACAMS or ICA within fraud or compliance is an advantage, though not a requirement. We welcome a variety of routes into this role, and your approach to the work and your colleagues matters as much as your formal background.

What we offer you

You will join a close-knit team that takes professional development seriously, regularly  knowledgesharing and following new trends in fraud prevention together. We work in a hybrid setup, typically spending three to four days a week in the office to support collaboration and team culture. You will have real opportunities to deepen your expertise in a field that continues to grow in significance.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you have questions about the role, please reach out to Kristian Husum on mail krhu@danskebank.dk or Henrik Rodenberg Ploug by phone at +45 30 36 92 46.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 3rd of December 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Change and Execution Lead (Temporary 18 mos)
jobs.description:
Make business change land — across 30+ markets in a global customer engagement platform implementation that is 80% people and process, 20% technology.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology. At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology with 115 years of experience bringing innovation to healthcare. In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to enable customer engagement excellence — empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability.

In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to drive customer engagement excellence - empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability. Now, as we embark on a global Customer Engagement Platform implementation affecting around 1,500 users across 30+ markets, we are looking for a Senior Business Change & Execution Lead to make sure change lands across LEO - so the platform is adopted, used, and delivers lasting value.

Your role

As Senior Business Change & Execution Lead, you will run the business-side change and delivery engine that turns strategy into outcomes. Working closely with the Head of Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, our Business Process Owners, Global IT, and implementation partners, you will ensure that governance runs, decisions move forward, markets are ready, and change lands - wave by wave during rollout, and release by release after go-live. Business Process Owners decide how processes should work; you make sure those decisions move, land, and stick.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Owning the business readiness and adoption roadmap across markets and rollout waves, covering milestones, risks and dependencies, aligned with Global IT's project plan.

• Driving change execution: readiness diagnostics, stakeholder mapping, communication and enablement plans, adoption tracking, and go-live preparation.

• Running the governance cadence, including Core Team and delegate forums, and preparing SteerCo decision material, with clear agendas, decision logs and follow-up.

• Leading regular touchpoints with market Business Leads, and coordinating across Global IT, implementation partners, platform vendors, regional teams and local markets.

• Creating executive materials, stakeholder communications, briefing packs and change narratives that reflect LEO Pharma's business context.

• After go-live: running the roadmap prioritisation process with Business Process Owners, and tracking adoption and business value so the platform keeps delivering.

You will also help ensure that learnings are captured and acted on throughout the implementation, so the approach improves wave by wave. This is not a passive coordination role — you will bring structure, recommendations, momentum, and follow-through.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you bring strong experience from complex business change, adoption, transformation, or global implementation environments. You know how to make change work in practice - not only how to design the framework.

We are especially looking for:

• Proven experience leading business change and adoption in large-scale, multi-market implementations.

• Hands-on experience with structured change methods such as ADKAR or equivalent; Prosci certification is a plus.

• Strong execution skills, including roadmaps, RAID, governance, delivery cadence, and readiness tracking.

• Experience defining and tracking adoption and business value metrics, and using them to drive prioritisation.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, including senior stakeholder and executive-level materials.

• Experience working with external implementation partners, platform vendors, and cross-functional global teams.

Experience from pharma, life sciences commercial operations, CRM platform implementation (such as Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud or Veeva), Agile delivery, or train-the-trainer models will be an advantage.

As a person, you are structured, persistent, and action-oriented. You simplify complexity, create momentum, and bring a clear point of view on what needs to happen next. You lead through influence rather than hierarchy - holding partners, process owners, and markets to their commitments while bringing people with you. You keep the end user in mind — because change that does not work for the field, the medical liaison, or the market team does not work at all.

What success looks like

• Markets are ready before each wave - go-lives happen without surprises, and Business Leads know what is coming and what is expected of them.

• Decisions move - governance forums produce clear decisions, owners act on them, and nothing sits unresolved in the log.

• Adoption is measured, not assumed - you can show where the platform is used, where it is not, and what is being done about it.

• Change is owned locally - Business Leads and market teams carry adoption in their markets, rather than relying on central push.

• After go-live, the roadmap reflects business value - priorities are transparent, agreed with Business Process Owners, and tied to measurable outcomes.

Your new team

You will join Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence in Ballerup, Denmark. We are a global team working at the intersection of business process, customer engagement, commercial excellence, and platform governance. Together, we partner with markets, functions, Global IT, and external partners to ensure change lands, adoption sticks, and our platforms deliver real value.

A note from the hiring manager

I'm building a team that partners with the business and owns the outcome - not one that waits to be told what to do. Our global Customer Engagement Platform implementation is mobilising now - and this role will be central to making it land, from the first wave through to long-term value.

I believe in partnership as the work, real ownership within clear guardrails, and progress over perfection. You are not a coordinator chasing status updates - you set the rhythm, bring a point of view, and make it easy for others to deliver. If you can walk me through a time you made change stick across markets - and what you learned when it didn't – I would like to hear from you.

The opportunity comes with visibility to executive level.

Contact and application

For additional information, please contact Lisa Munkvold, Head of Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, at LIMUN@leo-pharma.com.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact.  Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Application Engineer, you will help customers turn technical requirements into practical solutions using frequency converters, drives and power conversion technologies.

You will combine technical expertise with commercial understanding, supporting customers from the first technical discussion and pre-sales phase through solution design, quotation, project execution, testing and commissioning.

An important part of your role will be to support marine and electrification applications, including battery energy storage systems, helping customers select, size and successfully implement the right solutions.

Based in Silkeborg, you will join a small, experienced application team where everyone manages their own customers and projects while sharing knowledge and supporting each other.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Partner with our sales team and customers to understand technical requirements and design and size frequency converters, drives and power conversion solutions for customer applications.

• Act as trusted technical point of contact for key customers throughout the customer journey. This includes participating in customer meetings, project scoping and technical clarifications, and translating requirements into solutions and quotations.

• Manage the technical side of projects from pre-sales through implementation, verification testing and commissioning.

• Perform technical analyses such as harmonic distortion simulations, verification tests and evaluations against customer specifications, helping resolve technical challenges throughout the project.

• Share your expertise through technical presentations, product and software-tool training, and collaboration with sales colleagues, service partners and internal technical teams.

The role involves regular customer interaction and travel, primarily within Denmark and potentially Norway and Sweden. You can expect up to approximately 50 travel days per year.

**What We're Looking For

**We are open to different levels of experience. You may already have relevant industry experience, or you may be a recent graduate ready to build your career in a customer-facing technical role. Furthermore, you have:

• A relevant technical background e.g. in Marine Engineering, Electrical or Mechatronics engineering, or a technical trade or service background with extensive electrical understanding.

• A solid interest in motor control, frequency converters, drives and power conversion, with the technical curiosity to develop your understanding of products, systems and customer applications.

• Confidence working directly with customers and different stakeholders, combined with a proactive and structured approach to managing projects and priorities.

• Fluency in Danish and English, as you will work directly with Danish customers as well as colleagues and stakeholders across borders.

• Willingness to travel and work directly with customers and partners on-site when needed.

Experience with marine applications, electrification, drives, power conversion or related industries is an advantage but not essential. Familiarity with Danfoss Drives products or Salesforce is also beneficial.

Most importantly, you bring initiative, curiosity and a willingness to learn. If you are newly graduated, we are interested in your potential and motivation, not just the length of your CV.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll have the opportunity to develop a combination of technical, commercial and project management skills while taking real ownership of customers and projects.

Rather than focusing on only one stage, you can follow solutions from the initial customer requirement through design, implementation and commissioning.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues while building hands-on knowledge of frequency converters, drives, power conversion and electrification technologies, including applications within the marine industry.

The role offers a hybrid working model, with an expectation of being in our Silkeborg office two to three days per week.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you enjoy combining technology with customer interaction and want to take ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation, we'd like to hear from you.

If you're at the beginning of your career, don't let that hold you back. We welcome applications from motivated recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. You don't need to meet every preferred qualification to make an impact in this role.

For more information about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Application Engineering, Daniel Aksel Sandgaard at +45 3010 3176 . For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Lisa Tveen Bachmann, at +45 2859 4039.

Apply and help us turn customer challenges into drive and electrification solutions that move our customers forward.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

At Sumary, we are rebuilding finance from first principles. In short, we are creating the AI operating system for accounting work. Founded in 2025, Sumary is already used by some of the largest accounting firms in the world, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton and Baker Tilly, and the products we ship will define how finance teams work in the coming decade.

We have raised $29m, including the largest seed round ever in the Nordics, from Singular, byFounders, Partech and Tenity, and angels including Tuomas Artman (Linear), Morten Primdahl (Zendesk), Steve Anavi (Qonto), Stanislas Polu (Dust), Steffen Tjerrild (Synthesia), Jannick Malling (Public) and Ben Freeman (Omnea).

Our engineers are also our product managers and designers. You talk to customers, understand their pain points, design the best solution and ship it to a standard that sets the bar for the industry. You are confident owning features end to end, from the data model to the last pixel of the interface.

AI writes most of our code, so producing code is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is: deciding what is worth building, and making it excellent. Just because something takes half a day to build doesn't mean it should exist.

We are a small team of full-stack generalists, TypeScript end to end, and product comes first in everything we build. What unites us is a deep care for craft, fast execution and the discipline to say no. We are looking for experienced engineers who thrive on autonomy and individual responsibility.

We have offices in Copenhagen and London. Copenhagen is our engineering hub, and this role is based there.

**Come help define and build the future of finance.

**What you'll do

• Work closely with founders and customers, and turn what you hear into the right solution, which is often not the one they asked for

• Build new user-facing features end to end, with beautiful and scalable UI components

• Obsessively improve performance, so every interaction feels instant, even for our largest accounting firms

• Use what you built the way a customer would, and polish it until it is right before it ships

• Delete by default: push back on scope, on features we shouldn't build and on anything that feels off

• When an agent gets something wrong, fix the tooling so it doesn't happen again for anyone

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building customer-facing products at a company known for the quality of its software

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and React, and confidence across the full stack: Node.js, Postgres and the data model underneath

• Product obsession and a good eye for design: you care about UX, speed and polish. You notice the slow interaction, the awkward empty state and the setting nobody needs, and you fix them without being asked

• A track record of shipping complete features end to end, not only incremental work

• Comfort working without a product manager. You would rather talk to the customer yourself

• High ownership: you take a problem from start to finish and care about how it lands

• You know the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality

• You build AI-first, directing agents through the implementation while you own the judgment

Nice to have

• Experience as one of the first engineers at a startup that went on to scale

• Interfaces you designed yourself, not only built

• Experience with financial and ledger data

Our stack

TypeScript end to end: React and Next.js, Node.js, Postgres and Supabase, Temporal, Modal and our AI service layers. We don't expect you to have used all of it.

Applying

Along with your CV, send us something you built that you are proud of, and one thing in a product you use every day that you would fix.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Process Scientist - New Tablet Drug Products
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As (Senior) Process Scientist, you will help move new tablet products from development into reliable, large-scale production. You will characterise, test, and validate tablet production processes so they work at manufacturing sites around the world, and prepare the documentation that supports market approval. Oral treatments are a strategic focus area at Novo and your work will help our patients and customers towards lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• An M.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant academic area.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in oral product production, late-stage product development, drug product analysis, or clinical manufacturing

• General experience working within a GMP environment, knowledge of validation activities, and familiarity with regulatory documentation.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with team success ahead of personal achievement.

• A self-driven, quality-minded approach, with good planning and time-management skills to meet ambitious deadlines.

• Comfort working with some unknowns and many stakeholders, and the ability to adapt, learn and stay in control when situations are challenging.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from cross-organisational projects.

We welcome applications from both experienced and more junior candidates. The scope of the role can be adjusted to your level of experience, providing an opportunity to grow into the position. If you meet the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Do

**You will work on late-phase manufacturing science for new tablet products, preparing processes for large-scale market production.

**You Will Have The Opportunity To

**

• Drive scientific progress to reach project milestones, delivering on characterisation studies, test runs, and process validation activities.

• Work with production sites to solve technical challenges with blenders, granulators, tablet machines, in-process control systems, and process analytical technologies (PAT).

• Update and maintain critical process documentation, quality statements, scientific rationales and health authority submission files.

• Apply and uphold the relevant standards. Where a standard does not fully fit the situation, use your own scientific judgement to find the best way forward.

• Learn from how new ways of working meet reality at the sites, adapt your approach, and help update the standard so others can benefit.

The role is based in Taastrup, with some workdays in Måløv, and includes up to 25 international travel days a year, depending on your project.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join New Product Introduction (NPI) within Tablet Manufacturing Science and Technology (TMSAT) in Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS). Tablet MSAT supports the global network of tablet manufacturing sites by introducing new products, managing the processes and quality of marketed products, and developing new technology to improve performance.

NPI is a rapidly growing department of around 20 colleagues, working with an expanding pipeline of tablet products. Together, we develop, scale up and validate blending, granulation and compression processes, and make sure the product’s stability, specifications and quality hold up. We work in cross-functional project groups, united by shared team goals, and we share experience and knowledge as we go.

You will collaborate closely with development departments, production sites, quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs and the scientists who support marketed products. The stakeholders you work with will change as projects move forward, so you will keep building your network.

**What You Can Expect Here

**Oral treatments are a strategic focus area for Novo, and the landscape is dynamic. That means varied projects, new ways to broaden your skills and a chance to see your work make a difference at sites around the world. You will have a highly engaged, supportive team around you, and room to develop your professional and personal competences as the department grows.

**Salary

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 638,200.00 to 938,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take new tablet products from development to patients around the world, apply for the (Senior) Process Scientist role by 26 November 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Chris Arnrød Andersen, Director at ciaq@novonordisk.com or +45-30752190.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Do you have experience in hotel housekeeping and enjoy leading a team? Are you organised, reliable and committed to delivering high cleaning standards? We would like to hear from you.

We have multiple positions available, with responsibilities adapted to your experience and the requirements of each hotel. We welcome applications from experienced housekeeping managers, supervisors and housekeeping professionals ready to take the next step into a leadership role.

About the roles

You will help coordinate daily housekeeping operations, support your team and ensure that guest rooms and public areas meet the hotel’s standards.

Working closely with hotel contacts and D5S operations management, you will organise tasks, monitor quality and follow up on room readiness. These are practical leadership roles where you will also assist with cleaning when needed.

Your responsibilities

• 
Plan and distribute daily cleaning tasks according to occupancy, departures and hotel priorities.

• 
Lead, motivate and support the housekeeping team throughout each shift.

• 
Inspect guest rooms, bathrooms and public areas to ensure consistent cleaning quality.

• 
Monitor progress and help ensure rooms are ready within agreed deadlines.

• 
Introduce and train new employees in cleaning procedures, equipment use and hotel standards.

• 
Communicate with hotel reception and management about room readiness, special requests and operational changes.

• 
Follow up on cleaning issues and ensure corrections are completed promptly.

• 
Monitor cleaning supplies, equipment and linen requirements.

• 
Report maintenance issues, damage and lost property according to hotel procedures.

• 
Ensure that hygiene and workplace safety procedures are followed.

• 
Assist with cleaning when necessary to support the team.

Who we are looking for

You should have experience in hotel housekeeping and understand the importance of both quality and efficient daily operations.

We are looking for colleagues who:

• 
Have supervisory or management experience, or strong housekeeping experience and the motivation to take on more responsibility.

• 
Can organise workloads and communicate clear priorities.

• 
Lead by example and treat colleagues with fairness and respect.

• 
Have a strong eye for detail and take pride in their work.

• 
Remain calm and solution-oriented during busy periods.

• 
Are dependable, punctual and comfortable taking responsibility.

• 
Can communicate effectively in English; Danish is an advantage.

Multiple opportunities within our hotel housekeeping operations in Aarhus.

Responsibilities suited to your experience and the assigned hotel.

An introduction to the workplace, procedures and quality standards.

Support and cooperation from D5S operations management.

The opportunity to develop your leadership skills and contribute to a well-organised team.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for an opportunity where you can make an impact, shape decisions, and accelerate your career?

If so, we are looking for dedicated, curious, and highly motivated graduates to join the DFDS Graduate Programme starting in September 2027.

**Be part of the movement - and play your part

**About The Role The DFDS Graduate Programme is a two-year fast-track programme for recent graduates with an interest in and passion for the maritime industry.

During the programme, you will complete three rotations across different areas of our Ferry Division. You will begin at our headquarters in Copenhagen, followed by a mandatory international rotation at one of our European hubs. Your final rotation at our headquarters will be tailored to your skills, interests, and our business needs.

Throughout the programme, you will gain broad exposure to both the operational and commercial sides of our Ferry Division while building valuable industry knowledge and professional experience.

Ferry Operations offers broad end-to-end exposure with sustainability, standardisation, and digitalisation at the heart of everything we do.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be To:

**

• Help design and develop the vessels of tomorrow, supporting our green transition through electrification, ammonia, and green methanol initiatives.

• Support the operation and maintenance of our fleet of more than 70 RoRo, RoPax, and passenger vessels, covering everything from dry dock planning to crisis management and contingency handling.

• Contribute to our standardisation and digitalisation journey across eight owned terminals and more than 20 third-party terminals, where safety remains our highest priority.

• Support fleet planning, equipment optimisation, and our intercontinental rail setup, connecting ferry and logistics operations across our network.

In the commercial part of our Ferry Division, you will work alongside colleagues across Europe, supporting both B2B and B2C markets.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be To:

**

• Support local and global sales teams and assist with key account management, ensuring our network is successfully marketed and sold across regions.

• Drive continuous improvement in customer service and booking processes through standardisation and digitalisation initiatives.

• Collaborate with IT teams to enhance and optimise our digital customer offerings.

• Work with operational teams to optimise routes and vessel capacity to meet customer demand.

• Support revenue management activities, including pricing optimisation and commercial performance analysis.

Across all rotations, you will work closely with highly skilled colleagues and engage with customers, suppliers, and partners throughout the maritime value chain. To support your development, each rotation will include both a dedicated manager and a mentor who will help you successfully navigate your learning journey.

Alongside hands-on experience at DFDS, you will participate in the Danish Shipping Education Programme, delivered by Danish Shipping. This programme consists of webinars, four seminars in Denmark, and one international seminar, covering key topics across the maritime industry.

****About You

****At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built on diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives. We are looking for candidates who:

• Have graduated from a relevant master’s degree by the start of the Graduate Programme in September 2027, preferably within maritime studies, supply chain, freight forwarding, logistics, sustainability, business, finance, engineering, or a related field.

• Have gained relevant experience through a student job, internship, exchange programme, or other extracurricular activities.

• Have no more than two years of full-time professional experience after completing your master's degree.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are collaborative team players who enjoy working with others and creating impact.

• Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn and develop professionally.

• Have an international mindset and are excited about working across cultures and locations.

Working at DFDS **Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the DFDS Graduate Programme, you will become part of a strong graduate network across the company and build valuable connections across our international business. We offer a steep learning curve, meaningful responsibility from day one, and three interesting rotations designed to accelerate your professional development.

Are we a match? Apply now.  If your skills, experience, aspirations, and personality match this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Please Apply By Uploading Your CV no Later Than 30 November 2026. When Applying, You’re Also Asked To Answer The Following Questions:

• Why are you interested in joining the DFDS Graduate Programme?

• How will the programme help kickstart your career?

• How do you expect to contribute to the programme and DFDS?

• What do you believe will be your biggest challenge(s) during the programme?

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**Visit our Graduate site here to learn more and meet some of our people.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

**HO Finance oversees accounting, tax, treasury, controlling and internal controls — driving value through financial stewardship, compliance, and forward-looking support. The role requires on top, a good understanding of the company's ERP and financial system interfaces, together with IFRS and Local Danish Gaap knowledge.

This person will be the backbone of Finance, making sure tight deadlines are met in a timely manner and in quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Be

**

• Lead a high performance multicultural accounting team consisting of Accounts receivable, Accounts payable, general ledger, controlling and customs.

• Ensure proper accounting, reporting and complete, timely and consistent financial accuracy of all records and assets.

• Provide management with periodic financial reports and analyses for management decision-making.

• Ensure an effective internal control environment.

• Support operations through responsibility of: accounting and financial reporting, month-end close, tax, internal controls, cash and debt management, working capital management, insurance, and risk management.

• Cooperation with external auditors for the annual reports in Satair DK and Satair UK incl. local tax computations and tax-reporting to authorities.

• Cooperation with internal auditors from Airbus Group.

Travel days to be expected are 2-4 yearly travels to Hamburg and Toulouse, 1-2 trips to UK as necessary.

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**You will be required to apply business experience, judgement and compliance knowledge to provide added value for the business therefore we are looking for a person with a Masters degree or similar education with a minimum of 5 years at a middle or senior level in a financial management function, preferably in a global wholesale/distribution organization or audit.

Good analytical skills; ability to see the bigger picture and derive mid to long term recommendations on the way forward to stakeholders and excellent communication skills is a must. Teamplayer and the ability to balance and align varying interests of stakeholders is a key feature to master in this position.

A digital mindset, proficient in SAP or similar business management system and mastery of Google suite solutions and AI preferred.

As the company language is English, excellent command of both written and spoken English is a must.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application no later than 30. November 2026 to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: _http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

_This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Data Regulation Counsel to support Veo’s work within data protection and emerging technology regulation. You will play a key role in the day-to-day operation of Veo’s compliance framework and help ensure that our products, services, development, and internal processes meet applicable regulatory requirements.

You will join the Legal Team, currently consisting of four full-time employees, and work closely with it, as well as colleagues across IT, Marketing, Product, and other business areas. While the role's primary focus is GDPR compliance, your tasks will also include operational compliance related to NIS2, the Data Act, the Cyber Resilience Act, and the AI Act.

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing Legal function and help build scalable, pragmatic compliance processes at a company experiencing significant growth and continuous development.

**You can expect tasks within a variety of areas, including:

**

• Supporting the implementation and day-to-day operation of Veo’s data regulation compliance framework, ensuring that established processes are followed and continuously improved.

• Assisting in ensuring that Veo’s products, services, and internal data processing activities comply with applicable data regulation requirements.

• Providing practical and solution-oriented support to teams across Veo on data regulation matters, with a focus on translating legal requirements into operational processes.

• Drafting, updating, and maintaining relevant policies, procedures, and documentation, including privacy notices, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, incident response procedures, and documentation required under the regulatory frameworks.

• Supporting the handling of operational compliance tasks, including data subject rights requests, personal data breaches, and security incidents.

• Contributing to drafting and facilitating training and awareness initiatives.

• Supporting the management of third-party relationships from a compliance perspective, including assisting with due diligence, contractual requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

• Contributing to the ongoing monitoring, development, optimization, and, where relevant, automation of compliance processes, ensuring that Veo’s approach remains scalable and aligned with business needs.

Previous experience with all of the above is not required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• A master’s degree in law or business law from a Nordic university.

• Solid experience with advising on GDPR and/or other data regulation. Experience from scale ups or law firms is an advantage but not required..

• An interest in and basic understanding of broader technology regulation (e.g. NIS2, AI Act, Data Act).

• A pragmatic and structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to translate legal requirements into commercial and operational solutions.

• An interest in working closely with stakeholders across different functions and with varying professional backgrounds.

• A solid understanding of and interest in technology and artificial intelligence.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

At Veo, the Legal Team is part of the Finance Department, and you will report to the Head of Legal. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate closely with our experienced Data Protection Counsel. We offer an informal working environment where individual contributions are highly valued, both professionally and socially. We encourage personal and professional development while providing a flexible work environment, even during busy periods.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.
